records.text: The anonymous eyewitness said the rifle seen on the rooftop looked smaller than the Mauser recovered by authorities.

appearances.snippet: But yeah, absolutely all black and the rifle looked smaller than the Mauser they recovered.

verification.notes: The published edited recording directly contains the anonymous witness saying the rooftop rifle looked smaller than the recovered Mauser. This verifies the attributed comparison, not its forensic accuracy.

records.text: Owens guessed that the prosecution probably did not call the anonymous eyewitness because his description of a smaller rifle did not fit what she called the federal narrative.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: But most crucially. He instantly immediately has maintained that that gun looks smaller than 30-06 and he tells me in other conversations that it looked like a 223. ... So that I would guess is probably the reason the prosecution did not want to call him forward. ... I'm guessing. A description doesn't go well with their fed sloppy narrative. And remember, I just want to remind you, in terms of that route going Losee Center over to the library, which she makes very clear that's the route that the shooter took, that that's why we thought we had to recover these items.
